lines.en: label day216:
scene hall_noon
School has ended for the day so I’m currently on a mission to find Makoto.
lines.zh: 今天的课已经结束，我现在正踏上了寻找 Makoto 的征程。

lines.en: She left class the second the bell rang and kept her head down for the entire day, so I never really got a good opportunity to pull her to the side and talk about whatever it is that’s bothering her.
lines.zh: 铃声一响她就离开了教室，而且一整天都低着头，所以我一直没能找到合适的机会把她拉到一边，问问到底是什么在困扰她。

lines.en: Now, some people might hear that and think, “Why not wake her up or shake her shoulder or something? If she needs help, you shouldn’t wait on it.”
lines.zh: 有些人听了大概会说：「干嘛不把她叫醒，或者晃晃她的肩膀什么的？她需要帮助，你就不该干等着。」

lines.en: But those people are wrong.
lines.zh: 但那些人错了。

lines.en: The worst thing you can do for someone going through hardships is forcibly insert yourself into them.
lines.zh: 对一个正在经历苦难的人来说，最糟的做法就是强行把自己塞进去。

lines.en: The hardships, I mean. Not the person.
lines.zh: 我是说塞进苦难里。不是塞进那个人里。

lines.en: Forcibly inserting yourself into {i}any{/i} person is kind of rude to do.
lines.zh: 强行把自己塞进{i}任何{/i}人，都有点失礼。

lines.en: Either way, if I am ever asleep, let me sleep.
lines.zh: 总之，要是我睡着了，就让我睡。

lines.en: And if you are going to wake me up, do it sexually.
lines.zh: 如果你非要把我叫醒，请用性感的方式。

lines.en: Do not tear me from my rest to make me talk about things I do not want to talk about.
lines.zh: 别把我从休息中硬拽起来，逼我谈我不想谈的事。

lines.en: It will only make things worse.
lines.zh: 那只会让事情变得更糟。

lines.en: scene happyplacesredux1
: Oh, Sensei. What are you doing just walking around the halls?
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei。您一个人在走廊上晃悠什么呢？

lines.en: : You’re not lost, are you? You look lost.
lines.zh: : 您该不会迷路了吧？您看起来就是迷路了。

lines.en: : Of course Sensei isn’t lost, Ami. He knows these halls just as well as he knows my body.
lines.zh: : Sensei 当然没有迷路，Ami。他对这些走廊的熟悉程度，就像对我身体的熟悉程度一样。

lines.en: I actually think I know Ayane’s body a little better, to be honest.
lines.zh: 说实话，我觉得我对 Ayane 的身体还要更熟一点。

lines.en: : Sensei, please tell Ayane you have no intentions of learning about her stupid body.
lines.zh: : Sensei，请您告诉 Ayane，您完全没有兴趣了解她那具蠢身体。

lines.en: : It’s not stupid. It’s a temple. A temple for Sensei to defile and-
lines.zh: : 那才不蠢。那是座神殿。一座等着 Sensei 来玷污的神殿，而且——

lines.en: : Have either of you two seen Makoto?
lines.zh: : 你俩有谁见过 Makoto 吗？

lines.en: scene happyplacesredux2
: Unfortunately, yes. But what do {i}you{/i} want with her?
lines.zh: : 很不幸，见过。不过{i}您{/i}找她干什么？

lines.en: : There’s something I need to talk to her about. That’s why I’m acting all suspicious and wandering around the halls right now.
lines.zh: : 我有些事得跟她谈。所以我才一副鬼鬼祟祟的样子在走廊里乱晃。

lines.en: scene happyplacesredux3
: Come to think of it, {i}she{/i} has seemed pretty out of sorts the last few days.
lines.zh: : 说起来，{i}她{/i}这几天确实看起来不太对劲。

lines.en: : She left class almost immediately instead of coming over and talking to you.
lines.zh: : 她几乎是立刻就走了，都没过来跟您说话。

lines.en: : And yes, I keep track of her because, even if she’s bossy at times, she has nice legs and looks good without her glasses on.
lines.zh: : 没错，我一直在留意她，因为就算她有时候很爱使唤人，她腿很好看，摘掉眼镜的样子也不错。

lines.en: : I disagree and think she looks like a...stupid person who only wants to hook up with my [uncle].
lines.zh: : 我不同意，我觉得她看起来就是个……只想跟我[uncle]上床的蠢货。

lines.en: : Hate to break it to you guys but this is kind of important, so if you could leave your feelings about Makoto out of this and just tell me where she is, it would be great.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断一下，不过这事挺重要的，所以你们能不能先放下对 Makoto 的个人好恶，直接告诉我她在哪儿，那就再好不过了。

lines.en: scene happyplacesredux4
: Wow. You actually seem kind of serious.
lines.zh: : 哇。您看起来还挺认真的。

lines.en: : If she’d be anywhere, it would probably be downstairs at her locker.
lines.zh: : 她要是在哪儿的话，大概在楼下她的储物柜那边。

lines.en: : I think Miku said something about her staying in bed a lot the last few days, but I don’t care about her so I kinda didn’t think anything of it until now.
lines.zh: : 我好像听 Miku 说过她这几天老赖在床上，不过我不在乎她，所以直到现在才想起来。

lines.en: : Do you want us to come with you? Or maybe just me, at least?
lines.zh: : 您要我们陪您一起去吗？或者至少让我去也行？

lines.en: : I might be able to get through to her better than you can since I’m also a [teenage]girl head over heels in love with-
lines.zh: : 我也许比您更能说到她心里去，因为我同样是一个为您神魂颠倒的 [teenage]女孩——

lines.en: scene happyplacesredux5
: Uh-oh! Better head downstairs quick if you want to catch her, Sensei. Ayane will only slow you down.
lines.zh: : 哎呀！Sensei，您要是想赶上她，最好赶紧下楼。Ayane 只会拖您后腿。

lines.en: : Maybe! But that’s just because the amount of love I carry with me is heavier than Mt. Fuji.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧！但那只是因为我身上背负的爱，比富士山还要重。

lines.en: scene black
I nod to Ami and Ayane and quickly head downstairs to see if I can catch Makoto before she leaves.
lines.zh: 我朝 Ami 和 Ayane 点点头，赶紧下楼，想赶在 Makoto 离开前截住她。

lines.en: Normally, I would have at least said goodbye or something, but the chances are that if Makoto gets back to the dorm before I see her, she won’t open it for me even if I come visit.
lines.zh: 平时我至少会说声再见什么的，不过要是 Makoto 先我一步回到宿舍，那就算我去找她，她多半也不会给我开门。

lines.en: scene makotolocker1
I find Makoto amidst a crowd of other students, fumbling to open her locker with shaky hands.
lines.zh: 我在一群学生中间找到了 Makoto，她正用颤抖的手笨拙地想打开自己的储物柜。

lines.en: No one is paying much attention to her, so I, too, begin to drown them all out.
lines.zh: 没怎么有人注意她，于是我也开始把周围的一切都屏蔽掉。

lines.en: Before long, the two of us are engulfed in silence.
lines.zh: 没过多久，我们俩就被沉默吞没了。

lines.en: I watch her fail to pull it open three times before deciding to speak out.
lines.zh: 我看着她连着三次都没拉开，才决定开口。

lines.en: : Makoto.
lines.zh: : Makoto。

lines.en: scene makotolocker2
: Oh. Hello, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哦。您好，Sensei。

lines.en: : Is there something I can do for you?
lines.zh: : 请问有什么我能为您效劳的吗？

lines.en: : Do you need any help opening your locker? You seem to be having a little trouble.
lines.zh: : 需要我帮你开储物柜吗？你看上去有点费劲。

lines.en: scene makotolocker3
: I’m not having any trouble at all.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不费劲。

lines.en: : I always fail a few times before managing to open this stubborn thing.
lines.zh: : 我只是每次都要失败几次，才能把这个顽固的家伙弄开。

lines.en: : The door just gets stuck whenever it wants to.
lines.zh: : 这柜门想什么时候卡住，就什么时候卡住。

lines.en: : Damn thing doesn’t even care about how busy some of us are.
lines.zh: : 这破玩意儿根本不在乎我们有些人有多忙。

lines.en: : And what are you busy with, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那你究竟在忙什么？

lines.en: : Do you have somewhere to be?
lines.zh: : 你有地方要去吗？

lines.en: : I have a date with my bed.
lines.zh: : 我和我的床有个约会。

lines.en: : And then before I know it, it will be tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 然后不知不觉，就到明天了。

lines.en: : Then I’ll go home and have another date with my bed.
lines.zh: : 然后我回家，再和我的床约一次会。

lines.en: : And then tomorrow will come again.
lines.zh: : 然后明天又会再来。

lines.en: : And then another day will pass by.
lines.zh: : 然后又一天过去了。

lines.en: : I’ll sleep more on the weekends.
lines.zh: : 周末我会睡得更多。

lines.en: : And more tomorrows will come.
lines.zh: : 然后更多的明天会到来。

lines.en: : Then I’ll come to[school].
lines.zh: : 然后我来[school]。

lines.en: : Then go back home and have another date with my bed.
lines.zh: : 然后回家，再和我的床约一次会。

lines.en: : It’s all a cycle.
lines.zh: : 一切都是个循环。

lines.en: : I just can’t get the head start I want until I can get my shoes out of this...fucking...locker.
lines.zh: : 我只是想抢个先，可这双鞋还卡在这个……操蛋的……柜子里。

lines.en: Makoto tries pulling it open again but her fingers slip off.
lines.zh: Makoto 又试着拉了一次，可手指滑开了。

lines.en: She almost falls and I go to catch her, but she regains her balance before we come into contact with one another.
lines.zh: 她差点摔倒，我伸手去接，可我们还没碰到，她就自己找回了平衡。

lines.en: scene makotolocker4
: Oh?
: Oh what?
lines.zh: : 哦什么？

lines.en: : You tried to catch me.
lines.zh: : 您刚才想接住我。

lines.en: : How polite of you.
lines.zh: : 您可真有礼貌。

lines.en: : Of course I did. You falling down and getting hurt would be an inconvenience for me.
lines.zh: : 我当然会。你要是摔了受伤，那会给我添麻烦。

lines.en: : Would it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : That’s nice to know.
lines.zh: : 知道这点真好。

lines.en: I take a step closer to her.
lines.zh: 我朝她走近一步。

lines.en: She does not move.
lines.zh: 她没有动。

lines.en: She just continues trying to pull her locker open.
lines.zh: 她只是继续试着拉开柜门。

lines.en: The poor girl probably hasn’t even unlocked it yet.
lines.zh: 这可怜的女孩大概连锁都还没开。

lines.en: She’s just standing here in a daze waiting for things to fall into her hands rather than doing anything to make them happen.
lines.zh: 她只是茫然地站在这里，等着东西自己掉进她手里，而不是做点什么让事情发生。

lines.en: She’d probably walk home barefoot before remembering she just needs to use a key.
lines.zh: 她大概会光着脚走回家，然后才想起来自己只需要一把钥匙。

lines.en: Then she’d probably fall asleep in the bathroom of the dorm, forgetting she needs a key to unlock the door to her room as well.
lines.zh: 然后她大概会在宿舍的洗手间里睡着，忘了自己还需要一把钥匙才能打开房门。

lines.en: Keys are always so hard to use when your hands are shaking.
lines.zh: 手在发抖的时候，钥匙总是特别难用。

lines.en: And it’s even harder to remember you need to use them in the first place, it seems.
lines.zh: 而更难的，似乎是一开始就想起自己要用钥匙。

lines.en: : Why don’t the two of us go talk somewhere?
lines.zh: : 我们换个地方谈谈怎么样？

lines.en: : Talk about what?
lines.zh: : 谈什么？

lines.en: : Is there something you want to say to me?
lines.zh: : 您有什么话要对我说吗？

lines.en: : There is.
scene makotolocker5
: Well, what is it?
lines.zh: : 那是什么呢？

lines.en: : What do you want to talk about?
lines.zh: : 您想谈些什么？

lines.en: : You turned down my blowjob the other day, so I doubt it’s anything sexual.
lines.zh: : 前几天您拒绝了我的口交，所以我猜不会是那方面的事。

lines.en: I turn around to see if anyone else wandering through the hall caught what she said, but it doesn’t look that way.
lines.zh: 我转过身，看看走廊上有没有别人听见她说的话，看起来并没有。

lines.en: No one reacts.
lines.zh: 没有任何人有反应。

lines.en: They all just keep moving as if they’re cogs in some sort of machine.
lines.zh: 他们只是继续往前走，仿佛是某台机器上的齿轮。

lines.en: And I am an engineer, attempting to make one cog start working again.
lines.zh: 而我是工程师，正试图让其中一个齿轮重新转动起来。

lines.en: : I want to talk to you about what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 我想跟你谈谈到底发生了什么。

lines.en: : Does that mean you know what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 那意思是您知道发生了什么？

lines.en: : No. It’s more of me {i}wanting{/i} to know.
lines.zh: : 不。更多是我{i}想{/i}知道。

lines.en: : You’ve been acting strange the last few days.
lines.zh: : 你这几天一直很不对劲。

lines.en: : And you’ve been acting strange the last few {i}months{/i} but I’ve never tried to change you back, have I?
lines.zh: : 您这{i}几个月{/i}来也一直很奇怪，可我从来没试着把您变回来，不是吗？

lines.en: : Even when you started coming to my job and saying all those super perverted things to me, I just let it happen.
lines.zh: : 哪怕您开始跑到我打工的地方，对我说那些超级下流的话，我也就随它去了。

lines.en: : No, you actually showed a fair bit of resistance.
lines.zh: : 不，你其实还是相当抗拒的。

lines.en: : Ooooooooooooooooooooh, right. Right. But then you kept pushing anyway.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦，对。对。可您还是一直得寸进尺。

lines.en: : And I was happy to oblige because I was curious about how far things would go.
lines.zh: : 而我也乐于奉陪，因为我好奇事情会发展到什么地步。

lines.en: : And now our relationship is stronger than ever~
lines.zh: : 现在我们的关系比以前更牢固了~

lines.en: : Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : Uhh...right.
: So what? You feel indebted to me or something?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？您是觉得欠我人情还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Or are you just worried that I’m acting strangely because you’re afraid you broke me?
lines.zh: : 还是说您只是担心我行为反常，因为您害怕是您把我弄坏的了？

lines.en: scene makotolocker6
: If that’s what it is, I can promise you’re not the one who broke me at all.
lines.zh: : 如果是这样，我可以向您保证，把我弄坏的人根本不是您。

lines.en: : And before you go {b}jumping{/b} any guns, let me just say that I’m perfectly aware that I’m the one who broke myself.
lines.zh: : 在您{b}急着{/b}下结论之前，我先说清楚：我非常清楚，弄坏我自己的人就是我自己。

lines.en: : Either me or {s}God{/s} god.
lines.zh: : 要么是我，要么是 {s}God{/s} god。

lines.en: scene makotolocker7
: But there is no god! There can’t be!
lines.zh: : 可是根本没有神！不可能有！

lines.en: : No god would let {b}that{/b} happen!
lines.zh: : 没有哪个神会容许{b}那种事{/b}发生！

lines.en: scene makotolocker8
Without thinking, I push Makoto up against her locker and wrap my hands around her wrists.
lines.zh: 我想都没想，就把 Makoto 按在她的储物柜上，双手攥住了她的手腕。

lines.en: She stops shaking entirely and peers directly into my eyes.
lines.zh: 她彻底不再发抖，直直地望进我的眼睛。

lines.en: No-
She peers {i}through{/i} my eyes.
lines.zh: 她{i}透过{/i}我的眼睛往里看。

lines.en: I don’t even know what she’s looking at.
lines.zh: 我甚至不知道她在看什么。

lines.en: : Right here?
lines.zh: : 就在这儿？

lines.en: : I guess if you want to, we can. Not like I care anymore.
lines.zh: : 您要是想的话，我们也可以。反正我已经不在乎了。

lines.en: : I didn't even put on underwear today. How crazy is that?
lines.zh: : 我今天连内裤都没穿。够疯狂吧？

lines.en: : You’re kinda hurting my wrists though, so could you maybe ease up a bit?
lines.zh: : 不过您有点弄疼我的手腕了，能不能稍微轻点？

lines.en: : What is going on?
lines.zh: : 到底怎么回事？

lines.en: : You tell me. You’re the one who got all aggressive in the middle of the hallway when I was just trying to open my locker.
lines.zh: : 该您告诉我啊。我只是在想打开柜子，是您突然在走廊中间变得这么有攻击性。

lines.en: : Before that, why are you acting like this? Why bring up something as nonsensical as god when I’m trying to actually talk to you?
lines.zh: : 在那之前，你为什么变成这样？我正想跟你好好谈谈，你为什么突然扯出「神」这种毫无意义的东西？

lines.en: : Slip of the tongue?
lines.zh: : 说漏嘴了？

lines.en: I begin to hear whispers of people around us, looking on in shock.
lines.zh: 我渐渐听到周围人震惊的窃窃私语。

lines.en: scene makotolocker9
: Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。

lines.en: : Looks like people might start spreading rumors if you don’t make some space between us, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，您要是不跟我拉开点距离，大家好像就要开始传谣言了。

lines.en: : Not like I mind, but I don’t think that would be good for your career.
lines.zh: : 我倒是无所谓，不过我觉得这对您的事业不太妙。

lines.en: : And just think about what Ami would say if she were to come down the stairs and see us pressed up against the lockers like this.
lines.zh: : 再想想，要是 Ami 从楼梯上下来，看到我们这样紧紧贴在储物柜上，她会怎么说。

lines.en: scene black
I let go of Makoto’s wrists and she quickly regains the little composure she had prior to me showing up here.
lines.zh: 我松开 Makoto 的手腕，她很快就恢复了在我出现之前仅有的那一点镇静。

lines.en: scene makotolocker10
: Boo...
: I thought something wonderful was about to happen.
lines.zh: : 我还以为要发生什么美妙的事了呢。

lines.en: : Let’s go to the roof. We’re drawing too much attention here.
lines.zh: : 我们去天台吧。在这里太引人注目了。

lines.en: : No thanks. I don’t like the roof anymore.
lines.zh: : 不了，谢谢。我已经不喜欢天台了。

lines.en: : What happened to it being your “happy place?”
lines.zh: : 那里不是你的「快乐之地」吗？

lines.en: : There are no happy places, Sensei. Just places where it’s slightly harder to be touched by the dark.
lines.zh: : 这世上没有快乐之地，Sensei。只有在那里，被黑暗触碰会稍微难一点。

lines.en: : Unfortunately for me, the last time we were up there, I was touched {i}a lot{/i}.
lines.zh: : 可惜对我来说，上次我们在那里的时候，我被触碰了{i}很多次{/i}。

lines.en: : I felt the dark all over me.
lines.zh: : 我感觉到黑暗爬满了我的全身。

lines.en: : I felt its hands crawl up my thighs and slip into my pants.
lines.zh: : 我感觉到它的手沿着我的大腿往上爬，然后滑进了我的裤子里。

lines.en: : I felt them split me open between my legs and explore my insides.
lines.zh: : 我感觉到它们从我的两腿之间把我撑开，探索我的里面。

lines.en: : And then {i}poof{/i}. Goodbye, old Makoto.
lines.zh: : 然后，{i}噗{/i}。再见了，过去的 Makoto。

lines.en: : Goodbye, everything.
lines.zh: : 再见了，一切。

lines.en: : But hello, new world.
lines.zh: : 但你好，新世界。

lines.en: : A brand new place where everything is just how I want it to be...
lines.zh: : 一个全新的地方，那里一切都如我所愿……

lines.en: : Absolutely-
lines.zh: : 绝对——

lines.en: : Fucking-
lines.zh: : 他妈的——

lines.en: : Horrible.
lines.zh: : 糟糕透顶。

lines.en: The students who had since gathered around us begin to disperse as we move further and further apart both physically and mentally.
lines.zh: 随着我们在身体和心理上都越离越远，那些围过来的学生也开始散去。

lines.en: This isn’t the Makoto I know.
lines.zh: 这不是我认识的那个 Makoto。

lines.en: And I have a hard time believing that this is the person she is underneath the layers she puts on to make herself more...professional or responsible or whatever it is she normally goes for.
lines.zh: 我很难相信，这就是她层层伪装之下的那个人——那些为了让自己显得更……专业、更负责任，或者随便她平时追求的那些东西而披上的外衣之下的人。

lines.en: This version of her is like all of her flaws were turned up to max.
lines.zh: 这个版本的她，就像是把她所有的缺点都开到了最大。

lines.en: They’ve taken over everything.
lines.zh: 它们占据了一切。

lines.en: Was she really so tired that she allowed this to happen?
lines.zh: 她真的累到任由这一切发生了吗？

lines.en: : When we walked home together, that night on the roof, what was going through your head?
lines.zh: : 那晚我们从天台下来一起走回家的时候，你脑子里在想什么？

lines.en: : You were silent the whole way back.
lines.zh: : 回去的路上你一句话都没说。

lines.en: : So were you.
lines.zh: : 您也一样。

lines.en: : We were silent together.
lines.zh: : 我们一起沉默。

lines.en: : I can’t remember what was going through my head.
lines.zh: : 我不记得自己当时在想什么了。

lines.en: : Perhaps a little of everything? Perhaps nothing at all?
lines.zh: : 也许什么都想了一点？也许什么都没想？

lines.en: : Can you please at least say something that makes sense?
lines.zh: : 你能不能至少说点有意义的话？

lines.en: : I can try, but what makes sense to me might not make any sense to you at all.
lines.zh: : 我可以试试，不过对我来说有意义的东西，对您来说可能完全没有意义。

lines.en: : If I were to tell you what really happened, you’d think I’m even crazier than you probably think I am right now.
lines.zh: : 要是我把真正发生的事告诉您，您会觉得我比您现在以为的还要疯。

lines.en: : So I will just sleep.
lines.zh: : 所以我就睡吧。

lines.en: : And then I will wake up tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 然后明天醒来。

lines.en: : And then I will sleep.
lines.zh: : 然后再睡。

lines.en: : And then wake up again.
lines.zh: : 然后再醒来。

lines.en: : And you’ll do the same.
lines.zh: : 而您也一样。

lines.en: : The same seven days.
lines.zh: : 同样的七天。

lines.en: : Over-
lines.zh: : 一遍——

lines.en: : And over-
lines.zh: : 又一遍——

lines.en: : And over-
lines.zh: : 又一遍——

lines.en: : And over-
lines.zh: : 又一遍——

lines.en: : Until everything melts down and reforms into one disturbing mass of flesh, complete with twelve smiles.
lines.zh: : 直到一切融化、重塑成一团令人不安的肉块，上面还长着十二张笑脸。

lines.en: : One for each girl in class that you [masturbate] to while all alone in bed at night.
lines.zh: : 一张对应班上一个女生——您夜里独自躺在床上对着她们[masturbate]的那些。

lines.en: I can’t get through to her.
lines.zh: 我说不通她。

lines.en: It was pointless even trying.
lines.zh: 连试都是白费力气。

lines.en: But how am I going to explain this to Miku?
lines.zh: 可我要怎么跟 Miku 解释？

lines.en: And how is Maki going to take it knowing that her daughter might never snap out of this?
lines.zh: 而 Maki 要是知道自己女儿可能永远走不出来，她会怎么受得了？

lines.en: What will happen to Makoto’s future?
lines.zh: Makoto 的未来会变成什么样？

lines.en: scene makotolocker11
: Don’t you think I’m better this way, [makotomaster]?
lines.zh: : 您不觉得我这样更好吗，[makotomaster]？

lines.en: : I won’t yell at you for anything anymore. You can do whatever you want to me.
lines.zh: : 我再也不会为任何事冲您吼了。您想对我做什么都行。

lines.en: : I’ll still help you with all of your paperwork and stuff, but don’t expect me to stay up late studying anymore.
lines.zh: : 您的文书工作什么的我还是会帮，不过别指望我再熬夜学习了。

lines.en: : And don’t expect me to stick around after class either. It’s all too bothersome now.
lines.zh: : 也别指望我放学后还留下来。现在一切都太麻烦了。

lines.en: : I just want to sleep.
lines.zh: : 我只想睡觉。

lines.en: : Good things only come when I’m asleep.
lines.zh: : 只有睡着的时候，好事才会来。

lines.en: : The only problem is that none of them are real.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，那些都不是真的。

lines.en: : But then again-
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来——

lines.en: {i}Nothing is real.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}什么都不是真的。{/i}

lines.en: scene makotolocker12
: So, are we done here? Or are you going to drag me up to the roof by force?
lines.zh: : 那么，我们说完了吗？还是您要硬把我拖上天台？

lines.en: : I’m not going to {i}drag{/i} you anywhere. I just don’t want to see you like this.
lines.zh: : 我不会把你{i}拖到{/i}任何地方去。我只是不想看到你变成这样。

lines.en: : That’s nice. I only had to snap for you to finally show me an ounce of compassion.
lines.zh: : 真好。原来只要我崩溃一下，您才肯对我露出一丝怜悯。

lines.en: : If I knew that’s all it would take, I would have jumped earlier.
lines.zh: : 要是我早知道只要这样就行，我早就跳了。

lines.en: : Jumped?
: Heheh~ Oops! Said too much!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 哎呀！说漏嘴了！

lines.en: : I’m fine. Really.
lines.zh: : 我没事。真的。

lines.en: : Just, not really.
lines.zh: : 只是，其实不是。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: : 不过那不重要。

lines.en: : See you in class tomorrow!
lines.zh: : 明天课堂上见！

lines.en: scene makotolocker13
Makoto leaves without ever opening her locker.
lines.zh: Makoto 始终没能打开柜子，就这么走了。

lines.en: She walks home in her indoor shoes.
lines.zh: 她穿着室内鞋走回了家。

lines.en: scene black
And then she goes to sleep.
lines.zh: 然后她就去睡了。
